notification_description: nbn® will soon be performing work to upgrade software on the network.  During this overnight activity, you will temporarily be unable to connect to the nbn network.
provider_outage_information: nbn will be deploying a software update to prevent possible network impact caused by an identified production defect in the next generation Optical Line Terminal (ngOLT). During this update, Provisioning and Testing & Diagnostics will not be available. The processing of fulfilment orders (AVC, & CVC) will be temporarily queued while work is underway, however RSPs may continue to successfully submit Orders via the nbn® Service Portal and API.
